decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the 25 items, many were accessories like towels, pillows, and cooking gear rather than actual backpacks. Among the backpacks, the QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) was the most compelling choice due to its high rating of 4.7, over 6,000 reviews, and versatile 45L capacity for under $40. The Granite Gear pack (prod_backpacks_041) was a consideration for its lightweight design, but reviews mentioned reliability issues with the straps. The sling bags (prod_backpacks_140, prod_backpacks_051) and hydration pack (prod_backpacks_027) were good for specific uses but lacked the general utility of the tactical rucksack. I chose the QT&QY pack for its superior value and proven customer satisfaction.
